# Copilot instructions

See [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Three critical rules: **never invent or correct
content** (all quoted text is verbatim from the 2016/2018 site), **never let the
page read as though the band is active** (it stopped in 2020; this archive was
built in 2026), and **do not host audio** — the five players are SoundCloud
embeds by the owner's explicit decision, and the unreleased catalog stays a list
of titles.
